name: Europäischer Fernwanderweg E1 - Teil Deutschland, Hessen (Gebiet Taunus Ost)
description_md:
Europäischer Fernwanderweg E1 - Teil Deutschland, Hessen (Gebiet Taunus Ost) is a 51.0 km waymarked hiking route located in Germany. It features 1056 m of ascent and 1286 m of descent.

This hard route is part of the international waymarked hiking network and is signposted as E1. Walking time is about 16 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule, with difficulty derived from distance and ascent. The route passes Frankfurt within 500 m, Senckenberganlage within 1100 m, and WestendGate within 1400 m.
